title: The Go Wall Out Summer Event 🤩
summary: Go Wall Out is our special framing event to celebrate summer. It's a great time to fill up walls with framed art, photos, vinyl records and more.
body_markdown:
It's the *fifth* annual Level Frames **Go Wall Out** Summer Event!


Starting today but only for a limited time, **frame three or more items for an automatic 15% off** across your entire order.


Save on anything you frame up when you go wall out - photos, artwork, collages, vinyl records, pet portraits, diplomas and more.


### Ou Top Ideas for Going Wall Out


It's the perfect time to frame online and fill empty wall space with special memories and moments. Read on for some of our favorite ways to take advantage of this special event and make your walls look amazing.


---


## 1) Go Big on a Gallery Wall


A beautifully framed photo or piece of art stands on its own just fine. But when the wall space allows it and you're ready to make a bigger statement, there is nothing like a well-curated gallery wall mixing framed artwork, photos and other mementos.


The great thing about gallery walls is that they don't have to be static. As you collect new frame-worthy pics and artwork, you can expand upon the layout or shake up the design to keep things fresh.


If you are ever in need of inspiration, we have a full range of curated[gallery walls you can customize](https://www.levelframes.com/gallery-walls) . As with other aspects of our online custom framing, you're in full control of the size and style of your design.


## 2) Send Framed Gifts


Frame something special to create a unique and thoughtful gift.


It could be an amazing family photo sent to all of your relatives, or an inspirational framed print your entire team would appreciate.


To make it even easier, we've curated a number of[popular frame styles perfect for gifting](https://www.levelframes.com/frames/styles) and designed to meet deadlines. You supply the photo and customize the frame, we'll print, frame and ship using the same premium materials you'll find in everything that leaves our studio.


We'll even complete your[framed photo gifts](https://www.levelframes.com/gifts) by wrapping them in quilted kraft paper and enclosing a personalized note with your message.


## 3) The Home Office Upgrade


If you're working from home during part of the week and have optimized your work space in every which way except for what's on the wall, why not spruce up the view with online custom framing?


Framed photos, collage frames, vinyl records and our framed memo boards are great options.


You may also want to consider inspirational artwork that helps keep you focused and in the zone, like these[framed Joey Roth art prints](https://www.levelframes.com/artists/joey-roth) that explore the creative process, or our[framed Travel Tracker map](https://www.levelframes.com/frames/prints/travel-tracker-map) for keeping tabs on future travel plans and past adventures.


## 4) Pick Up (or Download) New Framed Art


There are so many great places on the internet to discover and support new artists.


In the past, acquiring a new piece meant that your work was not yet over; you still needed to buy a frame or take the print into the custom frame shop.


With online framing, you can usually take care of the frame at the same time!


> Golden Gate Bridge print from the[Cameron Moll collection](https://www.levelframes.com/artists/cameron-moll) collection


When you[browse our featured artists](https://www.levelframes.com/framed-artwork) , the custom framing option is built right in so that your new artwork arrives looking great, fully protected and ready to hang.


There are also some solid sources of[free, downloadable art](https://www.levelframes.com/blog/5-resources-for-free-hi-res-images) that you can upload with us for printing and framing.


## 5) Bring Music to Your Walls with Framed Records


##


Several years ago, we were inspired to honor the art form of album cover art with a unique method of creating[framed vinyl records](https://www.levelframes.com/vinyl) .


The actual album cover shows in full, while the record peeks out of its sleeve.


These framed albums are a great addition to any gallery wall, and work especially well when displayed in multiples.


Browse our curated set of albums, or let us know your favorite artist or record and we will track it down for you.


You can also order a frame for a record you already have on hand - we'll send you[our DIY record framing kit](https://www.levelframes.com/vinyl/frame-at-home) and you'll have it up on the wall in no time!


## 6) Create Framed Pet Portraits for All Your Furry Friends


With our new AI Photo Editor, you can[transform your pet photo](https://www.levelframes.com/ai-photo-editor) into a stunning portrait – whether it’s a cartoon version, dreamy watercolor painting, impressionist masterpiece, or even a regal king or queen – and proudly display it in your home.


Simply upload a photo, choose a style, and watch the image transform in real time.


If you don’t like the first style, try out the others until you find one you love. Once you’ve crafted[an awesome pet portrait](https://www.levelframes.com/blog/amazing-framed-pet-portraits) , select a print size, customize the frame style, and place your order. We’ll print and frame with the utmost care, and have the artwork on its way to you within a week.


## 7) Personalize Framed Photos with Custom Text


A great photo captures a moment. Adding your own words can help preserve and highlight the story behind it.


We designed our[Personalized Framed Photos](https://www.levelframes.com/frames/personalized-frames) to solve that problem by creating a dedicated window opening below your picture for custom text, turning a single moment into a lasting, clearly remembered story.


By adding that second mat window beneath your photo, these personalized frames let you include the information your future self, or a gift recipient, will be grateful to have years from now. You can even add these text windows to any of our custom collage frames!


## 8) Frame up and protect the artwork you've been collecting


Finally, we'd be remiss not to mention the use case for which Level Frames was created in the first place.


If you have a growing collection of posters and art prints but all of them seem to be stuck in the original shipping tube or stashed in a closet somewhere, now is the time to frame them!


With online custom framing, you can[design a frame to fit your art](https://www.levelframes.com/custom-frames-online) and have the frames shipped to you. Or, send in your entire collection and let us handle the framing in our studio.


Either way, we've made the entire experience more convenient, affordable and intuitive so that you can enjoy more framed artwork and photos in your life.


---


The **Go Wall Out** Event is happening now, but won't last forever.


It's a great time to take on framing projects you've been meaning to get to, or fill empty wall space with your favorite moments and memories. As soon as you add a third item to any framing order, the 15% savings will kick in on those items and anything else you add. This is on top of any credits you may have in your Level Frames rewards account.


Happy framing!
